{"command": "cd /Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken; gh pr create --base main --head docs-fix --title "fix(docs): unblock localized API docs deploy" --body "## Problem

Deploy docs run 36200857199 failed building the \`sl\` locale:

\`\`\`
docs/sl/api/plugins/pantoken/logos/src/functions/getLogoMeta.md:10:139
RolldownError: Element is missing end tag.
\`\`\`

The Slovenian (fuzzy) translation of \`getLogoMeta\` contains a stray double backtick (\`\`\`\`width\`/...\`\`). \`escapeBareHtmlTags\` only recognized single-backtick spans, so it treated \`dist/<name>.png\` as code and left \`<name>\` unescaped. Markdown pairs the double backticks differently, which leaves \`<name>\` as a raw element, and the Vue compile fails.

## Fix

- \`escapeBareHtmlTags\` now matches code spans the way CommonMark does: a backtick run closes only at the next run of the same length.
- Added a regression test.
- Validated every \`docs.api:prose\` msgstr in all locale catalogs through markdown-it plus the Vue template parser. The old escaper fails once (\`sl\`), and the new one fails zero times.

## Other failures

- Release run 36203861395 failed only on \`@pantoken/plugin-lucide-lab@0.4.0\` (\`ENEEDAUTH\`, not on OIDC trusted publishing yet). That's fixed outside the repo." 2>&1 | tail -2", "explanation": "Open the PR.", "goal": "Create PR", "mode": "sync"}

I fixed the Slovenian catalog and pushed it to [PR #180](https://github.com/thedannywahl/pantoken/pull/180) as a third commit (`fix(l10n): retranslate stale Slovenian getLogoMeta API entries`). The PR isn't merged yet: its checks hadn't registered on the branch when I looked, and I haven't run the docs build locally.

It's the `.po` file ([l10n/sl/docs.api.po](l10n/sl/docs.api.po#L14830-L14841)), not the `.pot` template. Two `getLogoMeta` entries were stale translations still marked as needing review:
- **The description:** it still described the old PNG-size API and contained the stray double backtick that broke the build. It now has a new translation that matches the current `viewBox` wording.
- **The return value:** it said "SVG string" (copied from `getLogoSvg`). It now translates the actual `LogoMeta` text.

I removed the review flag from both. I also added a line about this to the existing changeset.

The same stale translation is still in every other locale's `docs.api.po`. They don't break the build, but they still describe the old API. Across locales, 115–154 API entries are marked as needing review, and 5,141 in `ar`. Retranslating those means rerunning the docs.api translation, so I've left it for a separate change.

Should I wait for the checks to go green and merge?
